subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: The Website That Hasn't Been Built Yet
description: Learn The Website That Hasn't Been Built Yet in one minute.

hook.text: Every world-changing website started as someone's side project or wild idea.

buildup.text: Google was a research project. Facebook was a dorm experiment. Shopify was a snowboard store.

discovery.text: The web's low barrier to entry means the next big idea could come from anywhere.

twist.text: You don't need permission, a factory, or investors to put something on the web.

climax.text: The most important website ever built might be the one someone is starting today.

punchline.text: The next world-changing site hasn't launched yet.

quiz.question: What do all world-changing websites have in common?
